summary:
Fix applied and verified.

**Change** (`regex-automata/src/dfa/onepass.rs`, match-finalization path in the one-pass DFA search): the code previously did `slots[explicit_slot_start..].copy_from_slice(cache.explicit_slots())`, which panics when the caller supplies more slots than the regex needs (cache slice shorter). Now it copies only the overlap (`min` of both lengths) and then applies epsilon slot transitions to the full caller slice, so regex-owned slots get captures, surplus slots are left as valid `Option<NonMaxUsize>` values, and shorter-than-needed slices behave exactly as before.

**Verification** (tool results, exit 0):
- `cargo test -p regex-automata --lib onepass`
- `cargo test -p regex-automata` (full crate test suite)

No tests, docs, or manifests were modified.
